188:t_2:54.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What's the problem? They're not causing any trouble.」

188:t_2:55.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If $$宇宙怪獣$$ appear, the members on $$タイタン$$ will fight to protect Earth too.」

188:t_2:56.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「We don't intend to cause trouble either. Transferees' freedom of action is recognized in the multiverse.」

188:t_2:57.en:
$$タケル$$
「We only wanted to know why. We live in the same world, so we'd like to help each other as much as possible.」

188:t_2:58.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! $$ノノ$$ agrees with $$タケル$$ too!」

188:t_2:59.en:
$$チコ$$
「You say that, but sometimes the other side doesn't want to be friends with us.」

188:t_2:60.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$明神タケル$$... Do you intend to get along with people like $$サイデリアル$$ too?」

188:t_2:61.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's different if they're invaders. I'll risk my life to fight evil.」

188:t_2:62.en:
$$タケル$$
「I swore to $$マーグ$$'s soul that I'd bring peace to space.」

188:t_2:64.en:
$$タケル$$
「My older twin brother. He's no longer in this world, though...」

188:t_2:66.en:
$$タケル$$
「Don't worry about it. $$マーグ$$'s soul still lives on inside me.」

188:t_2:68.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I never imagined he'd win over $$チコ$$ after $$ノノ$$. He must be quite the charmer.」

188:t_2:70.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You're going to make me angry.」

188:t_2:72.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Hey! We're about to descend into the atmosphere! Everyone, take your stations!」

188:t_2:74.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well then, everyone in the $$クラッシャー隊$$. If you have more questions about $$タイタン$$, please ask me anytime.」

188:t_2:75.en:
$$勝平$$
「Big Bro $$ニコラ$$ is as pretentious as ever.」

188:t_2:76.en:
$$恵子$$
「But he's rather charming. He's always so composed.」

188:t_2:77.en:
$$勝平$$
「He's like Big Bro $$万丈$$ that way.」

188:t_2:81.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Then let's take our stations too. Once we enter the atmosphere, the next operation starts immediately.」

188:t_2:82.en:
$$タケル$$
(That man $$ニコラ$$... He's hiding something...)

188:t_2:83.en:
$$タケル$$
(He's built a wall around his heart, so I couldn't make it out clearly, but that was...)

188:t_10:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You shouldn't worry about what $$尸空#pilot$$ said.」

188:t_10:6.en:
$n
「...But it's true I'm less experienced than you and $$ランド$$, $$セツコ$$. I admit that.」

188:t_10:7.en:
$n
「But I won't accept his claim that I can never surpass $$ガドライト#pilot$$.」

188:t_10:8.en:
$n
「For $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, who risked his life for me, too.」

188:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! I, $$ＡＧ$$, was deeply moved by your words, $n.」

188:t_10:15.en:
$n
「If you're praising me, does that mean some $$Ｚチップ$$s were produced?」

188:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, and you, $n, confronted $$尸空#pilot$$, the $$スフィアの共鳴$$ produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

188:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add those to the team's stock too.」

188:t_10:18.en:
$n
「Do $$Ｚチップ$$s form when the $$スフィア$$s resonate?」

188:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's... I don't really understand it myself, but let's just say all's well that ends well.」

188:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, I have to prepare to open $$Ｄトレーダー$$, so I'll be going.」

188:t_10:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $n... He still can't contact his company?」

188:t_10:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$n... You might want to keep an eye on what $$ＡＧ$$ does...」

188:t_10:26.en:
$n
「You mean he's going to betray us?」

188:t_10:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「No... That's not it. Maybe we feel this way because we haven't known him long, but he's... hiding something.」

188:t_10:29.en:
$n
(Something's been bothering me deep down all this time too...)

188:t_10:30.en:
$n
(But maybe I've avoided doubting $$ＡＧ$$ because I don't want to lose $$ジェニオン$$...)

188:t_10:31.en:
$n
(No, that's not it... I think... I want to believe in $$ＡＧ$$...)

188:t_10:37.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's been a while, $$ＡＧ$$. I'm glad you're doing well too.」

188:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$タケル$$... I'd like to ask you something in confidence.」

188:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... If $n had mental strength like yours, I think he could reach even greater heights.」

188:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, I'll offer as much compensation as I can...」

188:t_10:46.en:
$$タケル$$
「...I don't need that. $n is my comrade.」

188:t_10:48.en:
$$タケル$$
「But I'm not the only one training him. $$アルト$$, $$甲児$$, $$宗介$$, $$カミーユ$$, $$シン$$, $$カレン$$, $$竜馬$$, Captain $$アムロ$$, Major $$オズマ$$...」

188:t_10:49.en:
$$タケル$$
「We're all his coaches, his teachers, and his comrades.」

188:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That light of yours... I'm sure it will help $n someday.」

188:t_10:53.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, there's one more favor I'd like to ask...」

context_decisions: Takeru senses Nicola fear/impatience behind mental barrier. AG asks Takeru to train Hibiki and offers payment; Takeru declines payment and identifies existing mentors. Marg is explicitly older twin brother.
uncertain: 188:t_10:51: AG light metaphor preserved without assigning a new power name.
